description: Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms - Notify the Parliament Approved Date : Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act. No. 2 of 2013
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal notification under the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013. It specifically announces the parliamentary approval date for extending the operation period of this Act, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (new laws, acts, regulations, and statutory instruments). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories, making it clearly a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
